summary: Iteration 24 — password reset + email verification flows end-to-end validated. Backend pytest 12/12 PASSED. Frontend Playwright 10/10 checks PASSED including a real end-to-end reset (token generated → page navigated → success screen → auto-redirect to /login → login with new password succeeds → dashboard reached). Email service correctly falls back to console provider when RESEND_API_KEY is absent (delivery.provider='console', delivery.ok=true). Admin debug endpoint /api/admin/auth-tokens/recent is properly RBAC-protected (candidate gets 403). DialogDescription a11y warning gone from ProfileEditDialog.
critical_code_review_comments: services/email.py — `send_email` swallows Resend exceptions and returns {ok:false,error}. Good for never breaking the token-creation flow; consider an alert/metric counter for production so silent failures surface.

routes/email_auth.py:_frontend_origin — falls back to request host header when FRONTEND_URL is unset. Behind a CDN/proxy this can produce wrong links if Host header is stripped. Setting FRONTEND_URL explicitly in /app/backend/.env would harden this for production.

routes/email_auth.py — `EmailStr` from pydantic-email-validator rejects some valid-but-uncommon TLDs (e.g., .test, .local), so consider documenting that frontend client-side validation must mirror this strictness. Anti-enumeration guarantee is preserved (200 returned) but 422 on syntactically invalid emails is still possible — frontend already shows toast on err.response.detail.
routes/email_auth.py:list_recent_tokens — exposes raw tokens to any admin; given they're single-use and short-lived this is acceptable. Keep gated to admin only.

EmailVerificationBanner.jsx — `setSent(true)` is permanent (no re-arm). If user wants to resend after a previous attempt, they must reload. Cheap improvement: re-enable button after 60s with a 'Renvoyer à nouveau' label.

ResetPasswordPage.jsx — does not pre-validate token existence on mount. User with an invalid/expired link only sees the error after submitting. Optional: GET /api/auth/check-reset-token?token=… on mount and short-circuit to an explicit invalid-link screen.
server.py keeps growing (~3000+ lines) per iter23 review. routes/email_auth.py is correctly split out — good pattern.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Email service is in CONSOLE/dev mode (RESEND_API_KEY unset). Real outbound emails are MOCKED — links are only logged to backend stdout. To retrieve a token outside of /admin/auth-tokens/recent: `tail -n 200 /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log | grep -E 'reset-password/|verify-email\?token='`. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter24_email_auth.py is now the canonical regression for these flows. The anti-enumeration contract is verified (unknown email → 200 with same ok:true payload, no token row). EmailStr rejects some uncommon TLDs (.test) with 422 — frontend should keep simple HTML5 type=email validation which is more permissive but UX-fine. lucas.martin still has email_verified=null after this iteration (verify token was sent but not consumed). If a later iteration expects email_verified=true for lucas, re-run the verify step. Reset token TTL = 1h, verify token TTL = 24h, both stored in MongoDB with TTL indexes set in server.py ensure_indexes.
